analysis: This batch is documentation only. It contains CHANGELOG.md tail excerpts (head lines 4539-5345, which are historical release notes and appear unchanged in this PR) and removals of five changelog.d fragments (the Darkbloom watchdog, the dev/master CI workflow split, the macOS Darkbloom route, and the sandbox lanes). The d0fa58b1789e1894:0 unit has only file metadata, with no body or line numbers supplied. No source, protocol, key-handling, attestation, cache-storage or authorization code is changed in the supplied units. The CHANGELOG patch excerpt is truncated: it adds a v0.10.9 candidate section with pair-update, rollout and stop-solo guidance. Those operational notes do not alter security controls in any supplied unit. The removed fragments describe CI behavior: a watchdog with a token scoped to cancel and re-run runs and write check runs, and a dev/master workflow split that reduces checks on dev PRs. Removing the fragments is the usual consolidation of fragments into the changelog and does not change the workflows. The workflow files themselves are not in this batch, so I cannot confirm that CI controls such as Release Integrity, Docs Lint or Commit Signatures remain enforced on master. The review does not show them removed, but the next pass should check any workflow YAML changes in the PR. I found no regression against threat IDs TB-002, TB-003, TB-007, TB-011, TB-012, TB-013, TB-014 or T-041 in these units. T-041 was supplied as context, but the changelog lines only describe SSD cache behavior historically and assert no new at-rest behavior. The truncated v0.10.9 text and the unseen CI/workflow changes remain unverified.
